title: LinkPeer 1.4.0 Available
message: This update introduces the official CSE Alumni Network Hub, Cache-First offline architecture, web-matching email application launcher, interactive hashtags & links in notices, and UI performance enhancements.
features: Official CSE Alumni Network Hub with Jobs, Internships & Alumni Events
Cache-First (Stale-While-Revalidate) architecture for instant 0ms app startup and offline resilience
Pre-filled email application launcher matching web portal composer
Interactive URL link detection & hashtag recognition in Notice Board announcements
Dynamic Recent Opportunities Spotlight and Upcoming Event Highlights
Official IGIT CSEA Alumni Website portal integration (cse.igitalumni.in)
Recent-first jobs sorting & date-badge event timeline display
Production stability & smooth Material 3 visual optimizations
